name: Grark Lorkrub
label: Quest
description: Grark Lorkrub: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I tracked him across the Searing Gorge, through the mountain, and into the Burning Steppes. That traitor was caught red-handed giving the Blackrock orcs vital information about our day to day operations. I'm speaking of Grark Lorkrub.
He now sits in the Burning Steppes, safely under their protection - or so he thinks.
Take these shackles, friend. Find Grark, place the shackles on him and lead him through Blackrock Mountain. Do this and a tribute is yours.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Can you not see the power we gain by joining the legion of Blackrock?
